payloadVerification.comparison: Actual base64-decoded GetRecords and SubscribeToShardEvent data compared byte-for-byte against sent payloads; equal in original order. Subscription closed after initial-response frame plus one data event frame.

findings.finding: Delivered DescribeStreamConsumer is a management read event, not a data event; requestParameters contains consumerARN only, responseElements is null despite a populated native API response, and resources references the StreamConsumer ARN.

PutRecord, PutRecords, GetShardIterator, GetRecords, SubscribeToShard, ListShards, RegisterStreamConsumer and all three DescribeStreamConsumer calls succeeded; GetRecords and Subscribe delivered the two actual tiny payloads. Native call success does not establish CloudTrail category or projection.

PutRecord DryRun=true returned HTTP 400 DryRunOperationException. The STS session-policy-denied ordinary PutRecord returned HTTP 400 AccessDeniedException with explicit session-policy denial. Neither event envelope was delivered within the bounded window.

Only one log object containing one event arrived during 1080 seconds from StartLogging. Final GetTrailStatus showed a successful delivery attempt, no delivery-error field, and IsLogging=true. Cleanup listing contained exactly that log object and an empty CloudTrail prefix object. No inference about omission/redaction, responseElements, denied-call projection, ListShards category, or SubscribeToShard resource type is supported for missing envelopes.

A synthetic valid-format StreamId plus the correct StreamARN is accepted by DescribeStreamSummary and returns the owned stream without a StreamId field. StreamId alone fails InvalidArgumentException: Stream arn and stream name can't be empty at the same time. This is one sampled input, not universal validation coverage.
